text:
elaine-sales: Quick sync — AcmeCorp POC: need a concrete acceptance checklist we can hand to legal + eng. Goal is demo + 2-week pilot with golden prompts and regression gates.
arjun-se: ok, what are their must-haves? latency, hallucination rate, SSO?
elaine-sales: top asks: SSO + SCIM, data residency (EU), per-route SLA, and cost estimate for 2k QPS burst. Also security questionnaire in flight.
jessica-ps: from presales: define success criteria as 1) top-3 accurate answers for retrieval use case >= 88% on golden set, 2) P95 latency < 120ms on dev cluster, 3) no PII leakage incidents in 2-week run.
kim-ml: putting together golden dataset now. We should have 150 seed prompts across 3 intents: retrieval, summarization, rerank. Each prompt will have 3 golden references.
tyler-eng: ops note: for the latency target we recommend dedicated mode with reserved capacity; I'll draft a pricing delta for reserved vs hosted.
elaine-sales: good — can you include burst pricing *and* a fallback plan when capacity is exceeded (route to smaller model variant)?
tyler-eng: yes. Fallback policy: route to small-quant model (q4_0) with prefix cache enabled.
emi-cs: legal asked for data retention and audit log config. We should document KMS usage + retention=90 days by default.
arjun-se: for the eval harness, propose automated nightly runs + regression alerts on these metrics: exact-match ratio, rouge-L, hallucination flag rate. If any metric drops >3% from baseline, trigger rollout hold.
kim-ml: here's an example scoring config I plan to run nightly:
```yaml
baseline_id: acme_q1
metrics:
  - name: exact_match
    threshold: 0.88
  - name: rouge_l
    threshold: 0.70
  - name: hallucination_rate
    threshold: 0.03
regression_gate:
  action: hold_rollout
  delta_pct: 3
```
elaine-sales: perfect. We need that in the POC runbook + a short how-to for their SREs.
jessica-ps: timeline proposal: week0 onboarding + infra enablement, week1 ingest golden prompts & baseline, week2 live traffic pilot + regression monitoring. Total 3 weeks including buffer.
tyler-eng: I'll add a runbook section for toggling fallback and adjusting batch sizes if latency spikes.
emi-cs: security questionnaire note: they requested encryption at rest + in transit, SOC2 statement, and an option for on-prem connector.
arjun-se: blocker callout: their internal eval requires label adjudication — we need SME availability to adjudicate 200 mismatch items during week1. Can sales commit SMEs?
elaine-sales: yes, Acme will provide product SMEs but need a clear template for labels. I'll send a short CSV schema.
kim-ml: also: golden dataset parity check — we should seed fuzz tests to ensure paraphrase robustness.
jessica-ps: acceptance gating: 1) automated eval passes, 2) SME adjudication rate > 75% agreement, 3) SSO + SCIM smoke test green.
tyler-eng: pricing note to include in proposal: 2-week pilot estimated cost = $12k hosted credit or $9k reserved delta (with 10% reserved discount). I'll attach numbers to the doc.
elaine-sales: can someone draft a one-pager with checklist + timeline + pricing + security bullets? Then I'll share with Acme PM and legal.
arjun-se: I'll draft the eval harness README and scoring scripts. Will push to the shared repo and ping here.
deploy-bot: deployment queued: eval-harness/nightly-run -> staging (job 4721)
emi-cs: I've uploaded SSO test checklist to the shared drive, link: https://drive.company/acme/sso-checklist
elaine-sales: great — next sync Wednesday 10am PT. Action items: arjun: harness README + scripts; kim: golden dataset + fuzz tests; tyler: pricing + runbook; emi: security checklist; jessica: acceptance gate writeup. :thumbsup:
